system.description:
Veterans of the Wall facing the Red Waste: disciplined and grim.

  • Wall-Forged Dread: your Demoralise is harsher: enemies suffer −6 to Charisma checks and, on a failed Will save, have Disadvantage on all their attack rolls. Otherwise it works as Demoralise.
  • Siege Discipline: Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment or coordinating a defence.
